grammar.summary: 本课学习动名词作宾语（enjoy/finish + doing）。

points.title: 动词后接动名词
points.explanation: enjoy/finish/practice/mind 等动词后必须接 V-ing：I enjoy eating, but I don't enjoy paying. 动名词=把动作名词化。

points.title: while + 过去进行时
points.explanation: While I was having dinner, he... 进行时作时间背景。

examples.en: I was having dinner at a restaurant when Tony Steele came in.
examples.cn: 我正在一家餐馆吃饭，这时 Tony Steele 走了进来。
